summary: Re-tested the REBUILT 4-step area-first calculator plus backend regression. Backend pytest 14/14 pass. Calculator full flow works end-to-end with demo data (Haryana/DHBVN, ₹10L bill, 80k sqft roof): DISCOM auto-fill (₹7.9/kWh green banner), Step-3 area-needed box (1.22L sqft ≈ 1220 kW), 'Your area fits about 800 kW covering ~66%', use-full-area btn sets roof to 122,100 sqft. Results hero shows Net Monthly Saving ₹2,82,820 with full breakdown line (Current bill ₹10L → Solar covers −₹7,59,446 → still pay grid ₹2,40,554 + EMI ₹4,49,293 = outflow ₹7,17,180). All res-* KPIs render (cap 800 kW, cost ₹3.28 Cr, EMI ₹4,49,293, savings ₹91.13 L, payback 3.5 yrs). No NaN/Infinity/undefined. Empty-bill on step 2 correctly blocks with visible calc-step-error and toast. Edge low bill 5k → 6 kW / ₹815 sane. Lead submit → EFL-LEAD-* success. All 8 regression routes render 200 with no crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Calculator.jsx uses (Number(f.ratePerWatt) || rateForCapacity(capacityKw)) but f.ratePerWatt is only ever set from the Advanced tab's calc-rate input. Fine, but the initialState does not declare ratePerWatt — accessing it is safe (undefined→NaN→falsey→fallback), yet declaring it explicitly (ratePerWatt: '') would be cleaner and avoid a lint warning.

Very high bill (₹50L) with demo roof (80,000 sqft) still caps plant at 800 kW because fitKw=min(fullKw, areaCapKw). This is intentional (area-first) but users may misread it as identical to ₹10L; the area-limited banner already explains this — behaviour is correct.
Advanced 'auto size' toggle passes booleans to Segmented as .value; verified working. Segmented compares by ===, so keep option values as booleans (not strings).
server.py compute_intent, EPCRegister.contactPerson required (carried over from iteration_1) — non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_QA_Calc lead via calculator lead form (EFL-LEAD-2609-9626).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebuilt calculator (Calculator.jsx, ~625 lines) uses testids: load-demo-btn, calc-state, calc-city, calc-discom, calc-business, calc-billmethod, calc-bill/calc-units, calc-tariff, calc-install, calc-roof/calc-land, calc-shading, use-full-area-btn, toggle-advanced, calc-finpct, calc-rate-slider, calc-tenure, calc-escalation, calc-rate, calc-autosize, calc-capacity, calc-next-btn, calc-step-error, res-net-benefit/res-capacity/res-cost/res-emi/res-savings/res-payback, lead-name/lead-mobile/lead-email/lead-submit/lead-success. Math: fitKw = min(fullKw, roofAreaSqft/100 + landAcres*250). fullKw = annualUnits/(specificYield*0.85). Verified end-to-end. Backend unchanged from iteration_1.
